memoryBounds.note: This is a bound on application-owned float/WAV arrays, not a measured total browser heap or audio-engine internal memory. Capture cache cap is not a total 32MiB working-set claim. One abandoned OfflineAudioContext retains exclusive render ownership until its actual promise settles, despite public cancellation/deadline.
memoryBounds.sharedOwnerScope: One physical Offline render across BrowserWavNormalizer/RecorderController/Workspace instances within the same JS realm; a pending old render is included in the conservative 55,680,044-byte application-array bound together with replacement capture. No total browser heap bound or cross-tab global cap is claimed.

apiFacts.fact: Requires secure context and permission. Permission promise may never settle; cannot treat user silence as approval.
stop synchronously sets ended but does not dispatch ended; stop all late/owned tracks explicitly.
Worklet sampleRate is the associated BaseAudioContext rate, not the requested device channelCount or an assumed 48k.
Input channel arrays provide actual quantum lengths; do not hardcode 128 frames.
Explicit output channel count/frames/sampleRate; documented required supported rate range 8k..96k.
Returns a rendered AudioBuffer promise. This module does not invent close/abort APIs; cancelled results are discarded.
Direct new Worker(new URL(...,import.meta.url),options) and ?worker&url bundle static worker entries.

import http.server
import ssl
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path('/workspace/共享/Eliora/未来教室计划/web/dist')
CSP = "default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src blob:; base-uri 'none'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; form-action 'self'"

class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == '/fc/fixture':
            body = b'<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><title>Synthetic PCM fixture</title><button>Run isolated PCM</button>'
            mime = 'text/html'
        else:
            name = self.path.split('?', 1)[0]
            if name == '/fc/': name = '/fc/index.html'
            if not name.startswith('/fc/') or '..' in name:
                self.send_error(404); return
            path = ROOT / name[4:]
            if not path.is_file():
                self.send_error(404); return
            body = path.read_bytes()
            mime = {'.js': 'text/javascript', '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.svg': 'image/svg+xml'}.get(path.suffix, 'application/octet-stream')
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', mime)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.send_header('Content-Security-Policy', CSP)
        self.send_header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff')
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

server = http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 18443), Handler)
tls = ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER)
tls.load_cert_chain('/tmp/fc-round14-voice-https/cert.pem', '/tmp/fc-round14-voice-https/key.pem')
server.socket = tls.wrap_socket(server.socket, server_side=True)
server.serve_forever()
